content.title: Spanish Coffee Chat Quest
content.themeSummary: A cozy tavern path for building beginner Spanish speaking confidence.
content.goalSummary: Prepare for and complete a ten-minute Spanish coffee conversation with follow-up questions.

acts.title: Gather Conversation Gear
acts.summary: Build the prompts and practice rhythm needed before live speaking.

mainQuests.title: Draft the Coffee Chat Prompt List
mainQuests.description: Write practical Spanish openers, follow-up questions, and fallback phrases for a coffee chat.
mainQuests.doneCondition: At least twelve prompts are written in the conversation prompt list.

steps.description: Gather the Spanish prompts and notes needed for draft the coffee chat prompt list.
Practice the key conversation actions for draft the coffee chat prompt list aloud.
Record one review note that proves draft the coffee chat prompt list is ready.

sideQuests.title: Practice Three Speaking Sprints
sideQuests.description: Practice aloud with a timer using the prompt list and reflection tracker.
sideQuests.doneCondition: Three five-minute speaking sprints are recorded and reviewed.

steps.description: List the concrete requirements for practice three speaking sprints.
Prepare the tools or notes needed for practice three speaking sprints.
Review the finished artifact for practice three speaking sprints.

bossFights.title: The Ten-Minute Coffee Chat
bossFights.description: Complete a real or simulated ten-minute Spanish coffee chat without switching immediately to English.
bossFights.doneCondition: A ten-minute chat is completed and a short reflection is written.
bossFights.rewardIntent: Reward the milestone proof of conversation confidence.

skills.name: Speaking Practice
skills.description: Practice Spanish out loud with prompts, timing, and reflection.

skills.name: Conversation Planning
skills.description: Prepare useful openers, follow-up questions, and fallback phrases.

inventoryItems.name: Conversation Prompt List
inventoryItems.purpose: A practical list of Spanish prompts and fallback phrases for the chat.

inventoryItems.name: Reflection Tracker
inventoryItems.purpose: A notes tracker for reviewing speaking practice after each sprint.

achievements.name: First Coffee Chat Cleared
achievements.description: A real conversation milestone has been completed.
achievements.unlockCondition: Unlocked when the ten-minute chat is completed and reflected on.

focusedNextActions.title: Write twelve prompts
focusedNextActions.description: Write twelve Spanish coffee chat prompts in the prompt list.
